title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Terms — Earning, Keeping and Losing a Tier
content:
**1. Qualifying spend.** Tiers of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program are earned on the calendar-year qualifying spend: net merchandise dollars after discounts and Finch Notes and before tax, with any tender, excluding the purchase types that earn no points, less returns. On the membership's points history it is the qualifying amount on purchase points entries and on missing-points credit entries, less the qualifying amount on return deduction entries, dated from 1 January through 31 December of one calendar year (year to date when read during the year).

**2. Mid-year upgrade.** When the year-to-date qualifying spend reaches the qualifying spend threshold of a higher tier, the membership moves to the highest tier reached within the mid-year upgrade business days, the change being recorded as an upgrade, and the tier valid-through date becomes 31 December of the following calendar year.

**3. Annual review on 1 January.** A member whose tier valid-through date has passed is set to the highest tier whose threshold the previous year's qualifying spend meets, but never more than the largest number of tiers allowed down at one review below the tier held (the change recorded as a downgrade when lower); a member whose tier valid-through date has not passed keeps the tier.

**4. Card status floor (combination with Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards).** While the customer holds a card account in active status at Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard, the membership is at least Finch Circle Gold, and at Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard at least Finch Circle Platinum, the change being recorded as a card floor. When that card account leaves active status the floor stops and the next annual review applies the spend rule alone. A floor never lowers a higher earned tier. A card floor can only grant a tier that can be granted as a card floor.

| Card account in active status | Floor tier |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite | Finch Circle Gold |
| Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard | Finch Circle Gold |
| Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard | Finch Circle Platinum |

**5. Status.** A tier changes only while the membership is in active status, as the membership record shows it. A suspended membership changes tier only after reinstatement, at the next upgrade test or review.

The threshold and the upgrade bonus of each tier are those of the program's tier schedule.

## Worked cases (hypothetical; thresholds as in the tier schedule)

- A Finch Circle Silver member's year-to-date qualifying spend reaches 2600.00 in July. Both the Finch Circle Gold and the Finch Circle Platinum thresholds are reached; the membership moves to Finch Circle Platinum, valid through 31 December of the next year.
- At the 1 January review, a Finch Circle Diamond member whose valid-through date has passed and whose previous-year spend was 600.00 would meet only the Finch Circle Silver threshold, but moves down no more than one tier, to Finch Circle Platinum.
- A Finch Circle Diamond member who opens a World Elite Mastercard keeps Finch Circle Diamond; the floor of Finch Circle Platinum never lowers a higher earned tier.
- A Finch Circle Member whose Platinum Mastercard is active is at least Finch Circle Gold; once that account leaves active status, the next annual review applies the spend rule alone.
